accessibility.description: Word equation for photosynthesis. Inputs: light energy, water, and carbon dioxide. Outputs: glucose and oxygen. Condition: in the presence of chlorophyll.

display.title: Chlorophyll captures the light
display.body: **Chlorophyll absorbs light energy in plant cells, and photosynthesis stores that energy as chemical energy in glucose.**
display.aside:
Water and carbon dioxide supply the atoms for that glucose, and oxygen leaves the plant as a gas.

The light is not kept as light. It is transferred into the sugar the plant builds, so the plant holds that energy in a chemical form it can use later.
